{
  "verdict": "revise",

  "reasons": [
    "Grants section missing: artifact has no 'Grants' section or guidance on applying for UK grants (e.g., Boiler Upgrade Scheme).",
    "FAQ section missing: no homeowner-friendly frequently asked questions are provided.",
    "Actionable one-page checklist missing: the requested concise next-steps checklist is not present.",
    "Reference list links missing: instruction asked to include links to the research reference list; the artifact does not show references or links.",
    "Incomplete closing of 'Steps to get quotes and select an MCS-certified installer' section: ends abruptly with 'Ensure the contract in' and is not finished.",
    "Running-cost example not explicit: the document gives COP/SCOP ranges but lacks a simple worked example with explicit currency figures using research-provided data.",
    "Some required content present but not clearly labeled or organized as requested (e.g., costs, running costs, grants, FAQ) and the tone/structure could be improved for homeowner readability."
  ],
  "guidance": "Please produce a complete homeowner_explainer.md. Specifically: (1) add a Grants section with current UK schemes (e.g., Boiler Upgrade Scheme) and a clear how-to-apply guide; (2) add a short FAQ covering common questions on cost, noise, maintenance, suitability, and timelines; (3) include a concise one-page actionable checklist for next steps; (4) include links or citations to the research reference list and any other credible sources; (5) finish the 'Steps to get quotes and select an MCS-certified installer' section so it ends with a complete, actionable step; (6) include a simple running-cost example using figures from the research (e.g., assume X kWh/year heat demand and Y pence/kWh electricity, compute annual running cost and potential savings); (7) ensure all requested sections are clearly titled and formatted with headings, bullets, short examples, and callout tips; (8) keep the tone UK homeowner‑friendly and ensure accuracy by cross-checking figures from research_findings.md; (9) output Markdown in a single file named homeowner_explainer.md with links to the research reference list."
}
